text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High-severity alert — unusual egress of auth headers to third-party index from auth-proxy cluster (edge-us-west-2). Detected 120 suspicious requests in last 2m. Suggested runbook: contain / collect / rotate.

alice (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming scope — which pods/services?

ben (eng-sre): Looks like auth-proxy v2.3.1 behind ingress-nginx. A few requests show Authorization header forwarded in log payload to our log-forwarder sink.

carla (security): Copy. Is this the log-forwarder -> external-index path? Which index?

roger (devops): It's the staging -> log-indexer-us3 endpoint (external vendor), route tagged by legacy-forwarder config. I see recent config rollout at 2026-03-17T11:05 UTC that added headers.openly=true in forwarder chain.

alice (oncall): Stop new exports now. @roger can you disable the legacy-forwarder route (log-indexer-us3) for auth-proxy ASAP?

roger (devops): on it. Running:
```bash
kubectl -n infra patch svc legacy-forwarder -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"disable-forwarding":"true"}}}'
# verifying...
```

roger (devops): Disabled routing to log-indexer-us3. In-flight batch flush may still send a few events.

ben (eng-sre): Confirmed egress drop. Ingress to log-indexer-us3 showing 0 requests now. I pulled a sample event — header blob includes `Authorization: Bearer px_eyJleHAi...` (truncated).

carla (security): Treat any leaked tokens as compromised. We need immediate rotation for affected tokens/keys and scope assessment. Which tokens were in logs (service tokens, user tokens)?

ben (eng-sre): Preliminary grep: service-token header for svc-account:auth-proxy-svc and a few user auth cookies occasionally attached. Most common: the svc-account token.

alice (oncall): @carla @amy (legal) @maya (cs) — Potential customer-impact? Search for customer identifiers in the payloads and prepare a disclosure plan.

maya (cs): I'll start mapping possible customer IDs from the sample events. If PII/customer tokens are out, we'll need to notify affected accounts per policy.

amy (legal): Standby for a quick call if customers need notifying. Keep evidence safe.

carla (security): Action items: 1) Rotate all svc-account tokens that could be forwarded (auth-proxy service account). 2) Rotate any ingest keys used by legacy-forwarder. 3) Revoke any user session tokens found and force reauth where necessary. 4) Audit logs for timeframe 2026-03-17T10:50 -> 11:10.

ben (eng-sre): I'll rotate the auth-proxy service token first. Will create a new service token, update deployment secret, and restart pods. Steps:
```bash
# create new token
smithctl tokens create --service auth-proxy --env production --output new-token.txt
# update k8s secret
kubectl -n gateway create secret generic auth-proxy-token --from-file=token=new-token.txt -o yaml --dry-run=client | kubectl apply -f -
# rollout restart
kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy
```

ben (eng-sre): Started rotation now. Rolling restart in progress (3/5 pods restarted).

alice (oncall): Good. @ben, freeze any further config rollouts for forwarders until security okays.

ben (eng-sre): Agreed, tagging PRs: BLOCKED: forwarder-config until postmortem.

carla (security): Roger, also rotate the credentials used by legacy-forwarder to send to external-index (vendor API key). It may have been included in payload metadata.

roger (devops): Copy. Rotating vendor key and regenerating outbound creds. Will update the secrets store after rotation.

relay-bot: NOTE: New incident timeline entry created — INC-2026-03-17-0923. Assigned to carla (security) as lead.

carla (security): For containment, I've asked infra to block outbound traffic to log-indexer-us3 from our VPC in the firewall while we verify retention & copies.

roger (devops): Firewall rule applied: blocked egress tcp/443 to log-indexer-us3.host on 3 hosts.

ben (eng-sre): Restart finished. All new pods using rotated token. Verified outgoing headers no longer contain old svc token.

carla (security): Begin forensic collection: request full batch of forwarded logs between 10:45-11:10 UTC and snapshot config versions. Use for indicators of compromise. Keep chain-of-custody.

maya (cs): I found two customer account IDs in the sample logs — cust_27 and cust_112. Preparing initial outreach draft.

amy (legal): Preliminary review: notify affected customers within 48 hours if tokens tied to accounts. We'll need exact scope before sending. Keep communications templated.

alice (oncall): Any active customer-facing degradations? I don't see API errors in SLOs.

ben (eng-sre): No increased error rates. This looks like data exposure only; services remain healthy.

carla (security): OK — classification: data exposure of auth headers (possible tokens). Severity remains P1 for security response. Next: create rotation ticket for any user tokens found, and coordinate with CS for disclosure.

alice (oncall): I'm handing off to carla (security) and ben (eng-sre) for full remediation and postmortem. I'll stay available for escalation. Handoff at 11:55 UTC.

carla (security): Taking lead. Owners: ben = remediation/rotate, roger = forwarder creds + firewall, maya = customer comms, amy = legal review.

roger (devops): I'll also add a temporary policy to strip Authorization headers from any forwarded log payloads at the log-forwarder layer: catch-all redact rule.

ben (eng-sre): Implemented header-redaction rule on forwarder. Patch:
```yaml
forwarder:
  redact_headers:
    - Authorization
    - Cookie
```
Applied to prod-forwarder.

carla (security): Good. Keep a list of rotated secrets and their rotation timestamps in the incident doc. We'll need them for audit.

maya (cs): Draft copy ready, sending to legal for sign-off.

amy (legal): Please send drafts to me and keep CC:security, ops.

carla (security): Logging final notes: legacy-forwarder route disabled, vendor key rotated, auth-proxy svc token rotated, header-redaction applied, firewall block in place. Continuing forensic and scope.

relay-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff scheduled at 12:00 UTC. If additional escalation required, page execs.

alice (oncall): Handoff complete. Closing my active pager.

carla (security): I'll update INC-2026-03-17-0923 with remediation checklist and timeline and request postmortem.

ben (eng-sre): Leaving a short note: verified no residual egress to vendor, no service impact, rotation logs saved to secure-bucket/incidents/INC-2026-03-17-0923/.

maya (cs): Will prep CS queue and response templates for tomorrow morning.

amy (legal): We'll convene for 30m after final scope to approve customer notices.

carla (security): Thanks all. Ongoing items: forensic analysis, complete list of affected tokens/users, postmortem write-up. If you see anything else odd, ping me directly. :shield:
